title: Vehicle Financing Simulator
description: Simulate car or motorcycle financing payments with Price or SAC, down payment, term, monthly rate, and optional costs.
metaTitle: Vehicle Financing Simulator | Price and SAC
metaDescription: Simulate car, motorcycle, or other vehicle financing with Price or SAC. Enter down payment, monthly rate, term, and optional costs without embedded bank rates.

helpers.vehicle: Enter the cash vehicle price, down payment, and optional costs you want to test as financed or paid upfront.
helpers.financedCosts: Added to the financed balance as a user-entered assumption.
helpers.upfrontCosts: Included in total cost, but not charged interest in the schedule.
helpers.terms: Use the monthly rate from a quote or scenario. The calculator does not fetch bank rates or calculate official Brazilian CET.
helpers.sourceBadge: Formula 2026-06-25: Price and SAC with end-of-period monthly payments; no automatic IOF, CET, insurance, or fees.

compararMetodos.label: Compare Price and SAC with the same inputs
compararMetodos.help: Shows totals for both methods without changing the main schedule.

validation.valorVeiculo: Enter a vehicle price greater than zero and within the accepted limit.
validation.entrada: Enter a valid down payment greater than or equal to zero.
validation.custosFinanciados: Enter valid financed costs, or keep zero.
validation.custosAVista: Enter valid upfront costs, or keep zero.
validation.taxaJurosMensal: Enter a monthly rate from 0% to 20%.
validation.prazoMeses: Enter an integer term from 1 to 120 months.
validation.valorFinanciado: The down payment must be lower than the vehicle price plus financed costs.

source.title: Sources and scope
source.text: Constant-payment and interest/principal formulas were checked against Microsoft PMT/IPMT/PPMT documentation, with sources accessed on {accessDate}.
source.bcb: Central Bank of Brazil links are external references for calculators and rate lookup; no market rate is embedded.

items.estimativaEducativa: Educational estimate only; contract terms, lender due dates, and lender rounding can change values.
items.custosCetNaoAutomaticos: The simulation does not automatically calculate official CET, IOF, fees, insurance, registration, guarantees, or dealer costs.
items.custosOpcionaisInformados: Optional costs were treated exactly as entered; check whether the quote finances them or charges them upfront.
items.taxaAlta: Monthly rate above 10% is a high assumption; check whether you entered a monthly rate, not an annual one.
items.prazoLongo: Terms above 84 months are more sensitive to interest and costs; treat this as a risk scenario.
items.entradaBaixa: Low or zero down payment increases the financed balance and can raise total interest substantially.
items.custosAltos: Optional costs above 50% of the vehicle price look high; review the values entered.

price.title: Price:
price.text: keeps the payment nearly constant. Early payments carry more interest; principal grows later.

sac.title: SAC:
sac.text: keeps principal amortization constant. Payments usually decrease as interest is charged on a lower balance.

howToUse.title: How to use the vehicle financing simulator
howToUse.p1: Enter the vehicle price, down payment, costs to test, monthly rate, term, and amortization method. Results show total interest and a month-by-month schedule.
howToUse.p2: Use the monthly rate from your quote or create your own scenarios. The simulator does not fetch rates from banks, automakers, or dealers.

priceVsSac.title: Price vs SAC for car or motorcycle financing
priceVsSac.p1: With Price, the payment is more stable and its composition changes over time: more interest early, more principal later.
priceVsSac.p2: With SAC, principal amortization is constant and the payment usually starts higher then decreases each month.

entryAndTerm.title: How down payment and term change total interest
entryAndTerm.text: A larger down payment reduces the financed balance. A longer term can lower the payment, but keeps the balance open for longer and tends to raise total interest.

cet.title: Brazilian CET, IOF, insurance, and fees
cet.p1: Real quotes can include CET, IOF, fees, insurance, registration, guarantees, rounding, and specific due dates.
cet.p2: This version does not calculate regulatory CET or reproduce bank contracts. Enter optional costs when you want to test their financial impact.

examples.title: Car, motorcycle, and no-down-payment scenarios
examples.p1: The same formula works for a car, motorcycle, or other vehicle when you have price, down payment, monthly rate, and term.
examples.p2: To simulate no down payment, leave the down payment at zero. The warning reminds you that financed balance and total interest tend to rise.

disclaimer.title: Important notice
disclaimer.text: This calculator is an educational estimate. It does not calculate official CET, IOF, credit approval, insurance, fees, registration, documentation, or purchase/financing advice.

q1.question: How do I calculate vehicle financing payments?
q1.answer: Enter vehicle price, down payment, monthly rate, term, and Price or SAC. The simulator estimates financed balance, payments, interest, and the amortization schedule.

q2.question: Should I use a monthly or annual rate?
q2.answer: Use a monthly rate because Brazilian vehicle-financing quotes commonly show monthly interest. The equivalent annual rate is shown only as a reference.

q3.question: Does it include IOF, CET, insurance, and fees?
q3.answer: Not automatically. You can enter optional costs as financed or upfront, but the calculator does not compute IOF or official CET.

q4.question: Which is better for a car loan, Price or SAC?
q4.answer: It depends on the contract and your cash flow. Price tends to keep payments more constant; SAC usually starts higher and decreases over time.

q5.question: Does a larger down payment reduce interest?
q5.answer: Yes. A larger down payment reduces the financed balance, generally reducing total interest because less balance is exposed to the monthly rate.

q6.question: Can I use it for motorcycle financing?
q6.answer: Yes, if you enter price, down payment, monthly rate, and term. The calculator does not use brand, bank, or vehicle-model tables.

q7.question: Why can my bank quote be different?
q7.answer: Real quotes can use CET, IOF, insurance, fees, due dates, rounding, grace periods, guarantees, and contract rules that this estimator does not reproduce.
